Pizza Punks

City Centre, Newcastle upon Tyne

Pizza Punks is Newcastle's punk-spirited, build-your-own-pizza restaurant in the heart of the city. Dogs are welcome on the heated outdoor terrace where you can customise your pizza with unlimited toppings. The vibe is loud, fun and unpretentious — a great spot for dog owners who want good food without stuffiness.
